capabilities: Classify the open note and move it to the matching folder
Bulk-classify unclassified notes in a folder or the whole vault
Define attributes and sub-attributes with descriptions and target folders
Write category and subcategory properties to frontmatter
Automatically classify notes 10 seconds after editing stops
extras: The listing carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The key is stored in Obsidian's secret storage rather than plugin settings.
problem: Filing notes into the right folders and tagging them with a category is manual work that piles up as a vault grows.

relations.evidence: Get an API key at console.typesafe.ai/keys.

summary: AI classifier that picks a category for each note, writes it to frontmatter, and moves the file into the matching vault folder using the TypeSafe Jev model.
